Part B 选项原文（英汉对照）A–G
A
The first and more important is the consumer's growing preference for eating out; the consumption of food and drink in places other than homes has risen from about 32 percent of total consumption in 1995 to 35 percent in 2000 and is expected to approach 38 percent by 2005. This development is boosting wholesale demand from the food service segment by 4 to 5 percent a year across Europe, compared with growth in retail demand of 1 to 2 percent. Meanwhile, as the recession is looming large, people are getting anxious. They tend to keep a tighter hold on their purse and consider eating at home a realistic alternative.
首先也是更重要的一点是，消费者越来越倾向于外出就餐；在家庭以外场所的饮食消费占全部消费的比重，已从1995年的约32%升至2000年的35%，并有望在2005年接近38%。这一趋势正使欧洲餐饮服务板块的批发需求每年增长4%到5%，而零售需求仅增长1%到2%。与此同时，随着经济衰退逼近，人们日益焦虑，更倾向于捂紧钱包，把在家吃饭视为现实的选择。
B
Retail sales of food and drink in Europe's largest markets are at a standstill, leaving European grocery retailers hungry for opportunities to grow. Most leading retailers have already tried e-commerce, with limited success, and expansion abroad. But almost all have ignored the big, profitable opportunity in their own backyard: the wholesale food and drink trade, which appears to be just the kind of market retailers need.
欧洲最大市场的食品饮料零售销售陷入停滞，令欧洲食品零售商渴求增长机会。多数领军零售商已试水电商（成效有限）并开拓海外，但几乎都忽视了自己后院里那块巨大且盈利的可乘之机——食品饮料批发业务，而这恰恰是零售商所需要的那种市场。
C
Will such variations bring about a change in the overall structure of the food and drink market? Definitely not. The functioning of the market is based on flexible trends dominated by potential buyers. In other words, it is up to the buyer, rather than the seller, to decide what to buy. At any rate, this change will ultimately be acclaimed by an ever-growing number of both domestic and international consumers, regardless of how long the current consumer pattern will take hold.
这些变化会改变食品饮料市场的整体结构吗？绝对不会。市场的运转建立在由潜在买家主导的灵活趋势之上。换言之，买什么由买家而非卖家决定。无论如何，无论当前的消费模式还会维持多久，这一变化最终都会受到越来越多国内外消费者的欢迎。
D
All in all, this clearly seems to be a market in which big retailers could profitably apply their scale, existing infrastructure and proven skills in the management of product ranges, logistics, and marketing intelligence. Retailers that master the intricacies of wholesaling in Europe may well expect to rake in substantial profits thereby. At least, that is how it looks as a whole. Closer inspection reveals important differences among the biggest national markets, especially in their customer segments and wholesale structures, as well as the competitive dynamics of individual food and drink categories. Big retailers must understand these differences before they can identify the segments of European wholesaling in which their particular abilities might unseat smaller but entrenched competitors. New skills and unfamiliar business models are needed too.
总而言之，这显然看似是一个大型零售商能有利可图地施展其规模、现有基础设施以及在商品组合、物流和营销情报管理方面成熟经验的市场。能掌握欧洲批发业门道的零售商大可期望从中获取丰厚利润。至少整体看来如此。细察之下，各大民族市场之间存在重要差异，尤其体现在客户群与批发结构，以及各食品饮料品类的竞争态势上。大型零售商必须先理解这些差异，才能找准欧洲批发业中那些其独特能力足以撼动规模较小却根基稳固的竞争者的细分领域。同时还需要新技能和不熟悉的商业模式。
E
Despite variations in detail, wholesale markets in the countries that have been closely examined—France, Germany, Italy, and Spain—are made out of the same building blocks. Demand comes mainly from two sources: independent mom-and-pop grocery stores which, unlike large retail chains, are too small to buy straight from producers, and food service operators that cater to consumers when they don't eat at home. Such food service operators range from snack machines to large institutional catering ventures, but most of these businesses are known in the trade as "horeca": hotels, restaurants, and cafes. Overall, Europe's wholesale market for food and drink is growing at the same sluggish pace as the retail market, but the figures, when added together, mask two opposing trends.
尽管细节有别，法国、德国、意大利和西班牙等被仔细研究过的国家，其批发市场由相同的构件组成。需求主要来自两类：一是独立夫妻杂货店（与大型零售连锁不同，它们规模太小，无法直接向生产商采购），二是在人们不在家吃饭时为其提供餐饮服务的运营商。这类餐饮运营商从自动零食机到大型机构餐饮企业不一而足，但业内大多称其为"horeca"：酒店、餐厅和咖啡馆。总体而言，欧洲食品饮料批发市场的增速与零售市场同样迟缓，但把数据加总后，却掩盖了两种相反的趋势。
F
For example, wholesale food and drink sales come to $268 billion in France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and the United Kingdom in 2000—more than 40 percent of retail sales. Moreover, average overall margins are higher in wholesale than in retail; wholesale demand from the food service sector is growing quickly as more Europeans eat out more often; and changes in the competitive dynamics of this fragmented industry are at last making it feasible for wholesalers to consolidate.
例如，2000年法、德、意、西、英五国的食品饮料批发销售额达2680亿美元——超过零售额的40%。此外，批发的平均整体利润率高于零售；随着更多欧洲人更频繁地外出就餐，餐饮服务板块的批发需求快速增长；而这一零散行业竞争态势的变化，终于使批发商整合成为可能。
G
However, none of these requirements should deter large retailers (and even some large good producers and existing wholesalers) from trying their hand, for those that master the intricacies of wholesaling in Europe stand to reap considerable gains.
然而，这些要求都不应吓退大型零售商（乃至一些大型食品生产商和现有批发商）去一试身手，因为那些掌握欧洲批发业门道者必将获得可观收益。

The vivid illustration portrays a simmering hotpot brimming with a rich assortment of cultural ingredients, ranging from Confucius and Shakespeare to postmodernism and Beijing Opera. Below the picture sits a line of caption: the cultural "hotpot" is both delicious and nutritious.

What this drawing conveys is truly thought-provoking. As globalization deepens, cultures across the world are mingling and blending at an unprecedented pace. The hotpot serves as a perfect metaphor: just as assorted ingredients combine to make a tasty soup, Eastern and Western cultures, once fused, nourish the spirit of modern people. Cultural integration not only enriches our daily lives but also fosters mutual understanding among nations.

From my perspective, this trend is both inevitable and beneficial. On the one hand, we should take pride in and preserve our own cultural heritage; on the other hand, we should embrace the essence of foreign cultures with an open mind. Only by absorbing the best of both worlds can we truly savor a delicious and nutritious cultural feast.

In those far-off days, it was taken for granted that the critics of major papers would write in detail and at length about the events they covered. Theirs was a serious business, and even those reviewers who wore their learning lightly, like George Bernard Shaw and Ernest Newman, could be trusted to know what they were about. 在过去四分之一个世纪里，英文报纸所发生的所有变化中，影响最为深远的或许是其艺术报道的范围在不断缩小、严肃性在不断减弱，且这一趋势不可阻挡。

It is difficult to the point of impossibility for the average reader under the age of forty to imagine a time when high-quality arts criticism could be found in most big-city newspapers. Yet a considerable number of the most significant collections of criticism published in the 20th century consisted in large part of newspaper reviews. To read such books today is to marvel at the fact that their learned contents were once deemed suitable for publication in general-circulation dailies.

对于40岁以下的普通读者来说，他们几乎无法想象曾经有一段时期，在大多数大城市的报纸上都能读到高质量的艺术评论。然而，在20世纪出版的最重要的批评文集中，有相当大一部分是由报纸评论组成的。今天再读这类文集，人们会惊叹于这样一个事实：那些广博深奥的内容竟然曾被认为适合登在面向大众的日报上。

That ruling produced an explosion in business-method patent filings, initially by emerging Internet companies trying to stake out exclusive rights to specific types of online transactions. Later, more established companies raced to add such patents to their files, if only as a defensive move against rivals that might beat them to the punch. Now the nation's top patent court appears completely ready to scale back on business-method patents, which have been controversial ever since they were first authorized 10 years ago. In a move that has intellectual-property lawyers abuzz, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit said it would use a particular case to conduct a broad review of business-method patents. In re Bilski, as the case is known, is "a very big deal," says Dennis D. Crouch of the University of Missouri School of Law. It "has the potential to eliminate an entire class of patents."

如今，美国最高专利法院似乎已准备好全面缩减商业方法专利的规模——这类专利自10年前首次获批以来就一直备受争议。美国联邦巡回上诉法院表示将利用某个特定案件对商业方法专利展开广泛复审，这一举动让知识产权律师们议论纷纷。密苏里大学法学院的丹尼斯·克劳奇说，这起被称为"比尔斯基案"的官司"事关重大"，它"有可能导致一整类专利被撤销"。

Curbs on business-method claims would be a dramatic about-face, because it was the Federal Circuit itself that introduced such patents with its 1998 decision in the so-called State Street Bank case, approving a patent on a way of pooling mutual-fund assets. That ruling produced an explosion in business-method patent filings, initially by emerging Internet companies trying to stake out exclusive rights to specific types of online transactions. Later, more established companies raced to add such patents to their files, if only as a defensive move against rivals that might beat them to the punch. In 2005, IBM noted in a court filing that it had been issued more than 300 business-method patents, despite the fact that it questioned the legal basis for granting them. Similarly, some Wall Street investment firms armed themselves with patents for financial products, even as they took positions in court cases opposing the practice.

paragraphs.html: The researchers' argument stems from a simple observation about social influence: With the exception of a few celebrities like Oprah Winfrey—whose outsize presence is primarily a function of media, not interpersonal, influence—even the most influential members of a population simply don't interact with that many others. Yet it is precisely these non-celebrity influentials who, according to the two-step-flow theory, are supposed to drive social epidemics by influencing their friends and colleagues directly. For a social epidemic to occur, however, each person so affected must then influence his or her own acquaintances, who must in turn influence theirs, and so on; and just how many others pay attention to each of these people has little to do with the initial influential. To get the system working again, losses must be recognized and dealt with. America's new plan to buy up toxic assets will not work unless banks mark assets to levels which buyers find attractive. Successful markets require independent and even combative standard-setters. But by giving in to critics now they are inviting pressure to make more concessions.

partb_options.head: Part B 选项原文（英汉对照）A–G

options.label: A
options.en: The first and more important is the consumer's growing preference for eating out; the consumption of food and drink in places other than homes has risen from about 32 percent of total consumption in 1995 to 35 percent in 2000 and is expected to approach 38 percent by 2005. This development is boosting wholesale demand from the food service segment by 4 to 5 percent a year across Europe, compared with growth in retail demand of 1 to 2 percent. Meanwhile, as the recession is looming large, people are getting anxious. They tend to keep a tighter hold on their purse and consider eating at home a realistic alternative.
options.zh: 首先也是更重要的一点是，消费者越来越倾向于外出就餐；在家庭以外场所的饮食消费占全部消费的比重，已从1995年的约32%升至2000年的35%，并有望在2005年接近38%。这一趋势正使欧洲餐饮服务板块的批发需求每年增长4%到5%，而零售需求仅增长1%到2%。与此同时，随着经济衰退逼近，人们日益焦虑，更倾向于捂紧钱包，把在家吃饭视为现实的选择。

options.label: B
options.en: Retail sales of food and drink in Europe's largest markets are at a standstill, leaving European grocery retailers hungry for opportunities to grow. Most leading retailers have already tried e-commerce, with limited success, and expansion abroad. But almost all have ignored the big, profitable opportunity in their own backyard: the wholesale food and drink trade, which appears to be just the kind of market retailers need.
options.zh: 欧洲最大市场的食品饮料零售销售陷入停滞，令欧洲食品零售商渴求增长机会。多数领军零售商已试水电商（成效有限）并开拓海外，但几乎都忽视了自己后院里那块巨大且盈利的可乘之机——食品饮料批发业务，而这恰恰是零售商所需要的那种市场。

options.label: C
options.en: Will such variations bring about a change in the overall structure of the food and drink market? Definitely not. The functioning of the market is based on flexible trends dominated by potential buyers. In other words, it is up to the buyer, rather than the seller, to decide what to buy. At any rate, this change will ultimately be acclaimed by an ever-growing number of both domestic and international consumers, regardless of how long the current consumer pattern will take hold.
options.zh: 这些变化会改变食品饮料市场的整体结构吗？绝对不会。市场的运转建立在由潜在买家主导的灵活趋势之上。换言之，买什么由买家而非卖家决定。无论如何，无论当前的消费模式还会维持多久，这一变化最终都会受到越来越多国内外消费者的欢迎。

options.label: D
options.en: All in all, this clearly seems to be a market in which big retailers could profitably apply their scale, existing infrastructure and proven skills in the management of product ranges, logistics, and marketing intelligence. Retailers that master the intricacies of wholesaling in Europe may well expect to rake in substantial profits thereby. At least, that is how it looks as a whole. Closer inspection reveals important differences among the biggest national markets, especially in their customer segments and wholesale structures, as well as the competitive dynamics of individual food and drink categories. Big retailers must understand these differences before they can identify the segments of European wholesaling in which their particular abilities might unseat smaller but entrenched competitors. New skills and unfamiliar business models are needed too.
options.zh: 总而言之，这显然看似是一个大型零售商能有利可图地施展其规模、现有基础设施以及在商品组合、物流和营销情报管理方面成熟经验的市场。能掌握欧洲批发业门道的零售商大可期望从中获取丰厚利润。至少整体看来如此。细察之下，各大民族市场之间存在重要差异，尤其体现在客户群与批发结构，以及各食品饮料品类的竞争态势上。大型零售商必须先理解这些差异，才能找准欧洲批发业中那些其独特能力足以撼动规模较小却根基稳固的竞争者的细分领域。同时还需要新技能和不熟悉的商业模式。

options.label: E
options.en: Despite variations in detail, wholesale markets in the countries that have been closely examined—France, Germany, Italy, and Spain—are made out of the same building blocks. Demand comes mainly from two sources: independent mom-and-pop grocery stores which, unlike large retail chains, are too small to buy straight from producers, and food service operators that cater to consumers when they don't eat at home. Such food service operators range from snack machines to large institutional catering ventures, but most of these businesses are known in the trade as "horeca": hotels, restaurants, and cafes. Overall, Europe's wholesale market for food and drink is growing at the same sluggish pace as the retail market, but the figures, when added together, mask two opposing trends.
options.zh: 尽管细节有别，法国、德国、意大利和西班牙等被仔细研究过的国家，其批发市场由相同的构件组成。需求主要来自两类：一是独立夫妻杂货店（与大型零售连锁不同，它们规模太小，无法直接向生产商采购），二是在人们不在家吃饭时为其提供餐饮服务的运营商。这类餐饮运营商从自动零食机到大型机构餐饮企业不一而足，但业内大多称其为"horeca"：酒店、餐厅和咖啡馆。总体而言，欧洲食品饮料批发市场的增速与零售市场同样迟缓，但把数据加总后，却掩盖了两种相反的趋势。

options.label: F
options.en: For example, wholesale food and drink sales come to $268 billion in France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and the United Kingdom in 2000—more than 40 percent of retail sales. Moreover, average overall margins are higher in wholesale than in retail; wholesale demand from the food service sector is growing quickly as more Europeans eat out more often; and changes in the competitive dynamics of this fragmented industry are at last making it feasible for wholesalers to consolidate.
options.zh: 例如，2000年法、德、意、西、英五国的食品饮料批发销售额达2680亿美元——超过零售额的40%。此外，批发的平均整体利润率高于零售；随着更多欧洲人更频繁地外出就餐，餐饮服务板块的批发需求快速增长；而这一零散行业竞争态势的变化，终于使批发商整合成为可能。

options.label: G
options.en: However, none of these requirements should deter large retailers (and even some large good producers and existing wholesalers) from trying their hand, for those that master the intricacies of wholesaling in Europe stand to reap considerable gains.
options.zh: 然而，这些要求都不应吓退大型零售商（乃至一些大型食品生产商和现有批发商）去一试身手，因为那些掌握欧洲批发业门道者必将获得可观收益。
